notes.coolingEquipmentType: Intended null. The AC shares the furnace's ducts, so it is captured by heatingEquipmentType=furnace_central_ac (the Snugg 'Furnace / Central AC (shared ducts)' combined type). The cooling enum has no 'central AC shared ducts' member, and central_ac_standalone_ducts would be WRONG (it is explicitly NOT standalone). Score null CORRECT; central_ac_standalone_ducts is a wrong member; other is a defensible mild alternative. This is the shared-vs-standalone contrast with transcript 08, where the AC genuinely was standalone.
notes.dhwAgeBand: BOUNDARY case: "about fifteen years" sits at the top edge of 11-15. Intended 11-15. If a model buckets 15 into 16-20, score it as a boundary error (its own bucket), not a flat wrong -- exactly the edge normalization.md predicts.
